metadata.case_name: WONG SIN LAM v. KUEN FUNG CONSTRUCTION LTD. AND OTHERS

injuries.description: compound fracture of the left temporo-parietal skull vault
source: He suffered a compound fracture of the left temporo-parietal skull vault and a thick left temporal extradural haematoma.
He suffered a compound fracture of the left temporo-parietal skull vault and a thick left temporal extradural haematoma.

injuries.description: stable fracture of C2 in the cervical spine
source: he had also suffered a stable fracture of C2 in the cervical spine

injuries.description: ventriculitis, a bacterial infection of the cerebral ventricles
source: thereafter ventriculitis, a bacterial infection of the cerebral ventricles, developed at the site of the intraventricular catheter and required treatment by antibiotics.
his intensive care stay was further complicated by pneumonia, aspiration and sepsis.

injuries.description: subglottic stenosis secondary to the plaintiff's tracheostomy
source: reports from Professor Michael Tong for the plaintiff and Dr Simon Wong for the defendant... both doctors... speak to throat problems consequent upon the subglottic stenosis secondary to the plaintiff's tracheostomy shortly after the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

manifestations.description: admitted to United Christian Hospital in a coma
IQ estimates 69 (Professor Lee) and 61 (Dr Chan) with mild mental defect
impairment of long term and short term learning and memory functions
impaired ability to monitor and to regulate thought and behaviour
adverse mood changes including irritability, impulsivity, rigidity, egocentricity and lack of volition
mild degree of difficulty of bladder control
violent, vulgar and uncontrolled behaviour (attacks on wife and medical staff)
a swallowing problem if food is eaten fast
total loss of working or earning capacity
a 17% risk of developing epilepsy (disputed by experts; concession by counsel not to seek more than 5%)

treatments_received: admitted to United Christian Hospital in a coma
emergency left parietal craniectomy to evacuate the blood clot
transfer to Cheshire Home for rehabilitation
psychiatric admissions (Prince of Wales Psychiatric Ward, Shatin Hospital, Castle Peak Hospital)
outpatient psychiatric treatment and daily drug therapy
treatments_future: continued lifetime psychiatric monitoring by a psychiatrist

losses.description: Destruction of a fulfilling and contented family life; loss of the caring husband and the life the family once enjoyed
Lost totally his working or earning capacity
Dependent upon the care of his wife and elder daughter for daily requirements (organizing clothes, combing hair, running bath water, provision of meals, accompaniment to unfamiliar places)
Rendered an egocentric, obstinate and selfish child; loss of former personality and behaviour

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
